title: Herkle Hub for Roblox
features:
1. Copy Current Word (auto copy too)
2. Paste Current Word (auto paste too)
3. Say Current Word (auto say too)
4. Auto Type
>> Auto Type Features:
>>> Typing Method (Keypress, Remote, VIM)
>>> Typing Mode (Static, Random) (the speed before each keypress/typo)
>>> Typing Speed Range (if Random is selected)
>>>> Min Speed/Max Speed, does math.random(<min>, <max>) and waits that duration
>>>  Pretype Delay (can also be randomized)
>>> Submit Delay (can also be randomized)
>>> Dont Enter Word

5. Auto Typo
>> tells the auto type to imbed typos into words
>> Auto Typo features:
>>> No Early Typos
>>> Typo Method (Correct Letter + Typo, Incorrect letter, Double Tap Typos, Transposition Typos)
>>> Max Typos Per Word
>>> Typo Chance (can be randomized)
>>> Typo Backspace Delay (can be randomized) (how long to wait before getting rid of a typo)
>>> Typo Resume Delay (can be randomized) (how long to wait before resuming after omitting a typo(s))
>>> Continue After Typo (tells the script to type a few correct letters after a typo)
>>>> Max Letters After Typo
>>> Delete Full Word
>>> Lose After X Words

6. Always Correct Letter
>> spoofs all of your keypresses into the correct letter
>> MUCH better than Auto Type, it allows you to genuinely type words, but with no mistakes. undetectable and smooth.
>> Auto Enter If Extra Key (lets you smash your keyboard, and the script will enter the word if you press an extra key on top of the already correct word)
7. No Textbox Restrictions
>> removes WPM checks, anti-paste checks, letter case restrictions, special character restrictions, typing sounds, client -> server -> other clients word syncing (nobody can hear or see you typing),
8. Free Emotes
9. Auto Click Ducks
10. Show Admin Panel
11. Mod Detector
>> also comes with chat detection, so if anyone points out that you're cheating, in serverhops or turns off all features (panic mode, also works for mod detection)
12. Word Logger (for easier addition of words to the wordlist)
13. Player Mods
>> Allow Rotation (lets you rotate your character normally, without being forced to face forwards
>> Allow Movement (lets you walk around the map without being forced into a single spot)
14. Mini Mode (a miniature UI with JUST the current word in it. made for mobile users who just need to see the correct word, and want a smaller, less invasive UI)

join the discord for more updates! also check the github to create issue tickets and read more in-depth about each feature.
